pureIPCRepair.change: Extract byte-identical UUID predicate to pure leaf; delivery-values reexports it; IPC imports pure leaf and returns generic storage action on thrown recovery exception. It no longer loads node:sqlite through storage/error modules in pure Bun IPC units.
pureIPCRepair.qualification: Node integrated47 predates this production IPC change and is not claimed byte-identical to final IPC. Repaired Bun27 and focused final NodeIPC16 pass both OS on snapshots whose complete Desktop/AppLive598-path vectors match integrationTarget.

historicalRejectedGate.classification: Harness/module setup failure, not product RED: 24 passing cases plus one module-load failure on each OS, No such built-in module: node:sqlite in pure IPC import.

provedRuntime: Actual Node SQLite Store, delivery manager/owner, fetch and real HTTP; controlled external Electron UI/capture/STT boundaries.
47 passing cases per OS: owner9, quit2, senses6, loop14, recovery IPC16 on the named immutable Node snapshot.
Cleanup rejection tests close their controlled handle before throwing and retain actual cause/unsealed recoverable Store data while joining owned HTTP.
Real 10s HTTP request/body deadlines and SSE headers-only deadline with long-lived owner-controlled bodies are exercised by Loop tests.

Repaired Bun27 per OS (122 Linux/118 Windows assertions) and final current-source Node recoveryIPC16 per OS pass without test failures; focused Bun Omni verdict is not applicable and proves no Omni spawn.
notProved: Physical microphone/system-audio hardware acquisition, STT provider/network correctness, native screenshot permission or cancellation.

Full Electron Main bootstrap/IPC/window/OS wiring execution: Main index.ts is snapshot-bound here; separate Main source-cold qualification belongs to Root. Node wrappers exercise isolated actual services with controlled external boundaries.
No physical OS permission dialog cancellation; the contract aborts the waiter and fences late grant.
No universal shared daemon restart detection: only known owned PID/exit/credentials epochs and initial shared health.
No durable summary retry: confirmed completion may prompt once only for the still-foreground matching triple; recovery/stale completion cannot summarize.
No new whole-package/full-epic CI conclusion; this record contains change-scoped lanes only.

The other31 integrated Node cases are bound to their earlier snapshot; the three M13 source changes between it and final are listed explicitly. Final IPC16 and Bun27 qualify their current actual source snapshots; no byte identity of all original47 cases at final IPC is claimed.
